thread:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — had a few customers pinging me about the exact sequencing for the API rate-limit changes, Console rollout, and the Optimize recommendations feature. Can leadership confirm rough GA windows and any handoff docs? (short bullets would help)

Samir Khanna: +1 from infra — we need concrete canary dates so we can reserve capacity. Also want to know if Optimize influences default batching configs.

Priya Patel: Hey — short answers: Console feature parity beta -> targeted end of Q2 (beta invites next 3 weeks), Console GA -> earliest in early Q3 depending on beta signals. API rate-limit model (more fine-grained per-route tiers) will start a staged rollout next month as an opt-in toggle; full enforcement later in Q3. Optimize (auto-batching + quantization suggestions) alpha mid-May, canary to select customers June if perf looks stable.

Jordan Lee: To be explicit — beta Console will not forcibly change customer configs. It exposes new batching UI and rollout toggles. GA will include an API to set recommended profiles programmatically.

Alex Wong: Heads-up: kernel & compilation tuning for quantized models can add a 2-3 week validation window per model family. If we want Optimize canary in June, infra needs model list by 5/10.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Can we get that model list and the beta invite cadence in a doc? Customers want dates for migration planning.

Priya Patel: Action: I'll publish a short handoff doc by EOD Monday with: 1) concise GA windows 2) owners per deliverable 3) canary criteria (latency/P95, error budget) 4) migration notes. I'll tag owners.

Samir Khanna: For canary criteria, propose P95 latency regression <5% and error rate delta <0.1% vs baseline. If folks disagree, drop comments on the doc.

Ethan Rivera: Quick priority note — console parity + safe onramp for customers is top-3 this quarter. We'll accept minor schedule moves to avoid regressions, but want clear comms and migration guide.

Jordan Lee: I'll own the migration KB and sample CLI snippet for customers. Draft snippet below — feedback welcome: ```redwood migrate --from=legacy-console --to=console-v2 --preserve-routes```

Nora: Please include recommended messaging for enterprise customers (SLA impacts, testing checklist). I'll prep a canned email once doc is live.

Alex Wong: Also flagging that Optimize's recommendations will be opt-in initially and surfaced as suggestions in Console. We should include a prominent opt-in flow and preview so customers can A/B.

Priya Patel: Agreed. Doc will call out opt-in flow + telemetry allowed for recommendations. Will include a minimal sample policy snippet and a link to the perf dashboard.

calendar-bot: New event created: "Console Beta Kickoff — invites" 2026-05-01 10:00 PT — invitees: eng, product, cs

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. Will share notes with the customer-facing folks after Priya's doc. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Follow-up: publishing doc at https://redwood.internal/handbook/allhands-onramp (will ping here when live).
